tools.name: get_youtube_transcript
tools.description: Use this when the user shares a YouTube video link or ID, or asks to summarize, explain, quote, translate, take notes on, or chat about a specific YouTube video, lecture, podcast, or talk. Returns the full spoken text (captions) as one block, plus the title and channel. Accepts watch, youtu.be, Shor

tools.name: search_youtube
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to find YouTube videos or channels on a topic, for example 'find lectures on linear algebra' or 'popular videos about the Apollo missions', before reading or comparing them. Returns each result's title, video ID, link, channel, views, length, and upload date. Pass `conti

tools.name: get_channel_latest_videos
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what a YouTube channel has posted recently, or wants a channel's details (name, description, links) with its newest uploads. Accepts an @handle, channel URL, or UC... ID. For a channel's full upload history use list_channel_videos; to find a topic inside one channel use s

tools.name: search_channel_videos
tools.description: Use this when the user wants videos from one specific YouTube channel about a topic, for example 'what has @hubermanlab said about sleep' or 'find the MIT OpenCourseWare videos on recursion'. Searches only inside that channel. Pass `continuation` from a previous response for the next page.

tools.name: list_channel_videos
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to browse a YouTube channel's uploads beyond its latest videos, for example to see a creator's older episodes or find a video they remember from that channel. Returns the channel's uploads (its Videos tab) one page at a time. Pass `continuation` from a previous response

tools.name: list_playlist_videos
tools.description: Use this when the user shares a YouTube playlist, or wants to work through a course, lecture series, or podcast playlist video by video (for example to build study notes for each lecture). Returns the videos in playlist order, one page at a time. Pass `continuation` from a previous response for the

tools.name: get_credits
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how many credits their getyoutubetranscript.com account has left, or after another tool reports the account has no credits remaining. Returns plan and top-up credit balances. Calling it does not use credits.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_youtube_transcript, get_channel_latest_videos · Private data: get_youtube_transcript · Public sink: search_youtube, get_channel_latest_videos.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_youtube_transcript, get_channel_latest_videos · Private data: get_youtube_transcript · Public sink: search_youtube, get_channel_latest_videos

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_youtube_transcript" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

Returns the complete spoken text as one block - this API does not provide per-segment timestamps, so don't ask for or expect a timestamped breakdown." → after: "Use this when the user shares a YouTube video link or ID, or asks to summarize, explain, quote, translate, take notes on, or chat about a specific YouTube video, lecture, podcast, or talk. Returns the full spoken text (captions) as one block, plus the title and channel. Accepts watch, youtu.be, Shor"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
